model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants who selected each of seven criteria when evaluating a system, with the criteria listed along the vertical axis and the count of participants along the horizontal axis, ranging from 0 to 6. The bars are color-coded and sorted in descending order by participant count: “Relevant FCs” (dark purple, 6 participants), “FC Summary” (dark blue, 5), “Relevance Explanation” (teal, 3), “Clarity and Simplicity” (green-teal, 3), “Overall Summary” (light green, 2), “Filters” (bright green, 1), and “Veracity Explanation” (lime green, 1). Each bar’s length corresponds to the number of participants, with numerical labels displayed at the end of each bar for clarity. The chart visually emphasizes that “Relevant FCs” was the most selected criterion, while “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” were the least selected, each chosen by only one participant.
